text.en:
The name of the Tandubas Emergency Hospital in the Municipality of Sapa-Sapa, Province of
Tawi-Tawi, is hereby changed to Tuan Ligad- duang Lipae Emergency Hospital.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: December 20, 1979
